summary: Fees added $45-50 (2025), military discount, facilities; season, phone booking, 46 sites confirmed. Amps not on the page, left. Now closed for the season, reopens April 9, 2027. Lakefront holds.
note: Campground run by the Fredericktown Recreation District on Kokosing Lake, the Corps of Engineers flood-control lake 1.5 miles northwest of Fredericktown, at 18352 Waterford Road. Several sites along the shore; playground, large picnic area and a two-lane boat ramp. Reviewers (2019-21) fit 25-ft Class Cs and trailers; some sites have low branches. One 2020 review mentions a few long-term campers. --Claude
flags: Local park: the public can book an ordinary night by phone or in person (Fredericktown Recreation District). Google 4.4/129.
